EmailTemplate.subject: Qantas Customer Care - {!Case.CaseNumber}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Ref No: {!Case.CaseNumber}
Dear {!Case.First_Name__c}
Thank you so much for taking the time to contact us about your time in our lounge prior to your recent flight. Your kind words are very much appreciated.
We want you to board your flight relaxed and stress-free, so it was great to read about your experience in the lounge. The lounge team work hard to make you comfortable and they will be delighted to read your feedback, so I’ve sent a copy of your comments on to our Lounge Management to pass on to them.
We are grateful for your ongoing support and look forward to welcoming you aboard again soon.
Kind Regards
Qantas Customer Care
Qantas Airways Limited, ABN 16 009 661 901 10 Bourke Road Mascot NSW 2020 Australia
Note: This email was sent from a notification only address that cannot accept incoming email. Please do not reply to this message.
